question: With regard to infection with the hepatitis C virus (HCV), point out the correct answer:

options.opa: In the world, the most frequent route of transmission of HCV is vertical.
options.opb: If HCV is acquired in adulthood, it becomes chronic in 5-10% of cases.
options.opc: The majority of patients with chronic HCV infection have positive HCV antibodies.
options.opd: Acute HCV infection occurs with frank jaundice in more than 80% of cases.
